title: Florida House, District 31
what_it_does: Represents District 31 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Republican Matt Woodside won the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Daniel 'Dan' Cicirelli on Nov. 3. The seat's incumbent is Republican Tyler Sirois; the snippets did not confirm whether Sirois sought re-election, so Woodside is recorded as a non-incumbent.
verified_ballot_note: Central Florida Public Media's Aug. 18, 2026 live results: 'House District 31: Republican Matt Woodside won his primary and will face Democrat Daniel Lewis Cicirelli' (https://www.cfpublic.org/live-updates/live-updates-primary-election-day-in-central-florida). Cicirelli's campaign site and a Space Coast Rocket questionnaire confirm his candidacy. Research limitation: every WebFetch (Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, Division of Elections, county SOEs, news sites) was blocked and the search budget was capped, so this roster comes only from search-result snippets and should be re-verified against the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.
